QuestInfo.name: [Crimsonheart] Outside the Castle
QuestInfo.0: Have a conversation with Grendel the Really Old.
QuestInfo.1: Grendel the Really Old asked if you could get outside of the Citadel. Go outside through the door on the far right side. Be prepared to fight something big...
QuestInfo.2: You encountered Master Red Nirg when you went outside the Citadel.
